headline: Record revenue, return to non-GAAP profit, GAAP loss widens
summary_short: AAOI's Q2 2026 revenue rose 86.4% y/y and 27.0% q/q to $191.9M — a fifth straight record quarter — as GAAP gross margin slipped to 27.7% (from 30.3% y/y) and the GAAP net loss widened to $22.8M ($0.28/share diluted), even as non-GAAP net income turned positive at $5.5M.
summary_long: Revenue hit a fifth consecutive quarterly record at $191.9M (+86.4% y/y, +27.0% q/q) on an 800G shipment volume that more than doubled sequentially and strong CATV/1.8GHz demand. GAAP gross margin fell to 27.7% (30.3% y/y, 29.1% q/q), partly reflecting $3.6M of discontinued-product expense; non-GAAP gross margin held near flat at 29.8%. GAAP net loss widened to $22.8M ($0.28/diluted share) on higher R&D and SG&A tied to capacity expansion, but non-GAAP net income turned positive at $5.5M ($0.06/share) versus losses in both prior quarters. For Q3 2026 the company guided revenue to $255M-$290M and non-GAAP EPS to $0.11-$0.26. Cash rose to $499.7M and equity to $1.67B on continued share issuance.

drivers.explanation: CEO cited a fifth straight record-revenue quarter, an 800G shipment volume that more than doubled sequentially, and strong demand for high-speed optics and 1.8GHz CATV products.

GAAP gross profit grew with revenue, but GAAP margin (27.7%) trailed non-GAAP margin (29.8%) — the reconciliation table shows $3.6M of Q2-only discontinued-product expense pulling the GAAP figure down.
Operating loss widened as R&D rose to $34.9M and SG&A to $31.6M y/y, which the CFO tied to scaling production capacity for 800G and 1.6Tb products.
GAAP net loss widened on the same opex growth plus $4.9M share-based comp and $4.7M non-recurring expense; excluding these and other add-backs, non-GAAP net income was positive $5.5M.
A wider GAAP net loss combined with a higher diluted share count (81.6M vs 56.8M y/y) from capital raises deepened the per-share loss.

Cash grew mainly from equity issuance — additional paid-in capital rose from about $1.22B to $2.19B — rather than from operating cash generation, which the release does not separately disclose this quarter.
Equity nearly quadrupled y/y almost entirely from new share issuance (paid-in capital +roughly $968M), not retained earnings, which stayed negative.
CEO called Q2 a "pivotal quarter," citing the return to non-GAAP profitability and the 800G ramp; CFO said demand for 800G/1.6Tb capacity should outpace production into mid-2027.
